message.jaymospowers.scrub.rust: The sand scours the rust off.
jei.jaymospowers.straw_wisp: Stand in water (or at a water cauldron), sneak and use it to scrub blood and dirt off yourself and your armour, rotten blood too. Hold something in your other hand to scrub that instead. Sand does the same and scours rust off metal, a handful each scrub.
